title: Deeper/broader ACIS comparator release/artifact split and semantic-evidence ceiling
mode: Read-only review of primary project releases, documentation, and source/tests
scope: Refresh exact open-source DWG/DXF and ACIS comparator release/artifact identities.
Separate document codec, payload parser, ACIS model validation, kernel conversion, and native-consumer evidence.
Update only the existing PAR-07/S8 comparator manifest and optional composed checkpoint.

method.limitations: Claims are from public project release/documentation/source pages. No exact artifact was acquired or executed, so this updates peer freshness and evidence eligibility rather than qualifying parser behavior or proving a local defect.

sources.observed: GitHub lists v0.6.5 at short commit 289a616, released 2026-10-18, with ACIS/modeler changes and project-suite validation. docs.rs/crates.io latest still identifies v0.6.4. Visible ACIS round-trip tests check payload retention and same-codec behavior, not independent topology metrics or native acceptance.
sources.evidenceCeiling: v0.6.5 source-release claims are not transferable to the 0.6.4 published crate; a peer codec run is structural/differential evidence only unless separately backed by expected geometry and independent consumer results.

sources.observed: The latest listed cq-acis release is v0.3.12 at short commit e05a8f4, released 2026-10-16. It documents selected SAT/SAB/ASM profiles and geometry subsets. acis-core latest docs identify 0.3.11 and explicitly limit reference-closure claims; the cq-acis conversion route uses CadQuery/OCCT.
sources.evidenceCeiling: One experimental parser/converter lineage; bounded profile and shared OCCT kernel lineage do not qualify arbitrary SAT/SAB, DWG AcDs ownership, native acceptance, or independent kernel correctness.

sources.observed: Current project materials put STEP/IGES and general open data-exchange formats in OCCT core, while ACIS SAT and DXF are listed as Advanced Data Exchange Components/commercial extensions.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Stock OCCT or FreeCAD cannot be assumed to include an open-source ACIS reader. A commercial component requires exact artifact, license, and test-use preflight.

sources.observed: The repository describes a pre-release SAT/SAB author, a DXF R2018 writer, and a DWG route using patched ACadRust. Its stated ezdxf/ACadRust readback is not itself a B-rep semantic oracle.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Watchlist for scratch-only authoring; not an independent DWG writer, general ACIS reader, or native acceptance result.

assessment.planEffect: Require exact release/package/source/dependency binding and report codec, carrier parser, AcDs join, kernel, and native consumer as distinct evidence stages. Use ACadRust only at an exact pinned route; use cq-acis only for its admitted payload profile with full loss/topology accounting and analytic expected values. Keep obj2cad optional as a scratch author, not as an oracle.
